moves.when: during the last station of the previous transect

rover.label: PLACEHOLDER
rover.note: The rover is a mobile comms relay: it parks at a relay site for each transect and moves only during the last station of a transect (or the first leg); the walk ends at the rover.

walker_model.label: MODELED with PLACEHOLDER suit settings
walker_model.note: Minetti et al. 2002 cost of walking with a PLACEHOLDER suit and gravity factor; Mars gravity is outside NASA/TP-2010-216125's tested range.
